1. Website owner

2. Purpose

This website presents HousySpace's real estate consulting and brokerage services. It lets you contact us, request a valuation of your home, save a home search and browse information about properties and neighbourhoods in Barcelona. By entering and using it you accept this legal notice.
3. Terms of use
You undertake to use the website lawfully and in good faith, without damaging it or preventing other people from using it normally.
The forms are only for people over 18. The data you provide must be yours, true and up to date; if you include other people's data, you must have their permission.
Automated or mass extraction of the website's content is not permitted without our prior authorisation.
4. Property information, figures and neighbourhoods

Property information is what the owner provides to us or what is on record at the time of publication. Prices, conditions and availability may change without notice, and the information on this website is not a binding offer: before you decide anything we will give you in writing the information required by law. Properties marked “DEMO” or “demonstration” are examples and are not for sale or for rent.

HousySpace's activity figures (properties brokered, volume, rentals) are rounded down and refer to the years the company has been active. On the maps of brokered properties the location is approximate, and no addresses or data of the owners are published.

The information on districts and neighbourhoods (Living in Barcelona) is indicative and comes from public sources, such as the Ajuntament de Barcelona and the Institut Cartogràfic i Geològic de Catalunya, indicated on each page. It is not advice and does not guarantee the outcome of a purchase or a sale.
5. Images and illustrations

The photographs, videos and illustrations on this website belong to HousySpace or are used under licence from their authors or from image banks. Images labelled “Conceptual image” have been generated with artificial intelligence or are illustrative: they do not show a real property.
6. Intellectual and industrial property

The texts, design, code, name and logos of HousySpace, the illustrations and the rest of the website's content belong to HousySpace or to those who license them to us, and are protected by intellectual and industrial property law. Without our prior written authorisation you may not reproduce, distribute, publicly communicate or transform them, except for your personal use.

The base mapping of the maps is © Institut Cartogràfic i Geològic de Catalunya (CC BY 4.0). Google Maps is governed by Google's terms. The open data of the Ajuntament de Barcelona is used under its reuse licence.
7. Links to other websites

This website contains links to third-party sites: social networks, public administrations and professionals we work with. We do not control their content or their policies and we are not responsible for them. Each professional is responsible for their own services. If you want to link to our website, do so to its main address or to a specific page, without implying that HousySpace endorses your site.
8. Liability

We try to keep the website available and up to date, but we do not guarantee that it will work without interruptions or errors. We are not liable for damages arising from technical failures beyond our control, from improper use of the website or from the content of linked sites. This does not limit the rights that the law grants to consumers.
9. Data protection and cookies
How we process your personal data is explained in the [privacy policy](route:privacy), and which cookies and external services the website uses, in the [cookie policy](route:cookies).
10. Commercial communications

We do not send you commercial communications by electronic means without your prior and express consent (Article 21 of the LSSI). You can withdraw it at any time by writing to [info@housyspace.com](mailto:info@housyspace.com).
11. Complaints and claims

If something has not gone as you expected, write to us at [info@housyspace.com](mailto:info@housyspace.com) or call us on 613 084 804 and we will sort it out. As a consumer, you can also file a complaint with the Agència Catalana del Consum.
12. Governing law and jurisdiction

This legal notice is governed by Spanish law. For any dispute, the parties submit to the courts of Barcelona, unless consumer legislation recognises another jurisdiction; if you are a consumer, that of your place of residence.
13. Changes to this notice
We may modify this notice. The current version is the one published here, with its update date.
